mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in FEDFUNDS above 5% over two consecutive quarters signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves positive 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of quarters when FEDFUNDS > 5% for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE below 4.5% for three consecutive months indicates weakening labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, which in turn drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts positive 20-day forward returns in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in GDPC1 and HOUST above their previous 12-month maxima signals robust demand expansion, which boosts earnings expectations and supports higher equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both exceed previous 12-month maxima
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not statistically greater than zero in more than 70% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in INDPRO below its 6-month moving average for four consecutive months signals supply-side contraction, which raises input costs and depresses earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 6-month moving average for four consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves positive 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of such episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp month-over-month decline in RSAFS below its 3-month moving minimum indicates a significant drop in household savings, which may signal increased consumption and economic confidence, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS < 3-month moving minimum in month-over-month change
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly above zero in more than 60% of triggered months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS and a fall in CPIAUCSL by more than 0.2% month-over-month signals a tightening monetary policy with moderating inflation, which typically supports risk assets and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL falls by >0.2% month-over-month
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not statistically greater than zero in more than 65% of such episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in PAYEMS above its 12-month moving average for five consecutive months signals strengthening labor demand, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 12-month moving average for five consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly above zero in more than 50% of triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in GDPC1 and INDPRO below their 4-quarter moving averages for two consecutive quarters signals broad-based economic weakening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and INDPRO both below 4-quarter moving average for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly below zero in more than 60% of such episodes.
